snippet.description:

A dark presence began lingering in the Valley of the Sun, starting with senseless attacks on neighborhood pets and livestock before rapidly escalating to cold-blooded executions on the city streets. snippet.title: Prison Friendship Became California's Deadliest Criminal Duo
snippet.description:
In 1979, two former inmates reunited after serving prison sentences and began putting years of planning into motion. Lawrence Bittaker and Roy Norris formed a criminal partnership that would become one of the most infamous in California history. This documentary follows their journey from prison friendship to a carefully organised series of crimes that shocked investigators and communities across Southern California.

The episode explores their backgrounds, psychological profiles, preparations, and the disappearance of 16-year-old Cindy Schaefer. As investigators search for answers, the lack of evidence leaves authorities struggling to identify those responsible. Through expert analysis, witness accounts, and details from the case, this documentary examines how two dangerous offenders managed to operate undetected and how one of America's most notorious serial murder cases began.
